style.toneOfVoice: A personalised pet photo bauble, perfect for displaying your favourite photo of your beloved best friend. The photo is reverse printed onto a clear polyester layer and then inserted into the bauble. It is finished with a small engraved bone-shaped charm that can be personalised with the pet’s name.
